response.sql: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, project_count, 1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * project_count / AVG(project_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM funding_counts;
